structure Paid {p : Sheet G} {w : Rolls p} {T : Protection w} {W : Delays T} {Y : Bar W}
    (B : Wait Y) (a : Levels G) : Prop where
  kernel : a.clock.kernel = p.kernel
  bar : a.clock.bar=Y.value
  stage : a.clock.stage=p.profile
  firstZero : a.clock.J 0=p.first
  firstOne : a.clock.J 1=p.first
  lengths : a.clock.factor=w.L
  theta : a.clock.theta=T.theta
  pays m : W.betaEntry (a.clock.J (m+1)) ≤ a.clock.hatBeta m
  paysHigher m : p.first < a.clock.J (m+1) → W.scaleEntry (a.clock.J (m+1)) Y.value ≤ a.S.scale m
  periods i : B.minLength ≤ (a.S.period i).val
  volume m i :
    let j := a.clock.J (m+1)
    W.shells j * (1+a.clock.coverSize m+a.clock.coverSize (m+1))^(W.growth j) ≤ (a.S.side m i).val
  run (j : ℕ) : p.first ≤ j → ∃ k : ℕ,
    B.readyHere j ≤ a.S.scale k ∧ B.window j (a.S.scale k) ≤ k ∧
      ∀ i : ℕ, k-B.window j (a.S.scale k) ≤ i → i ≤ k+B.window j (a.S.scale k) → a.clock.J i=j

verdicts.summary: [L] states no counterpart of what [M] prints. [M] prints `All requirements~\ref{it:E-columns}--\ref{it:E-birth} and~\eqref{eq:E-marker-scales} can be met with`.
evidence: Upholds the narrowed claim: The claim says [L] has the comparison windows only abstractly, but Next/RANK/Station.lean:37-45 defines `bump`/`more` = ⌈log(P^b·P²)/log L⌉ and ⌈log(B¹⁰)/log L⌉ (that is, h_t(b) and v_t), with `width` = k − h_t(b) − v_t. `Allowed.plateau` (Station.lean:93-96) gives J_i = J_k on the window, `Ship.honoured` (Next/RANK/Voucher.lean:96) handles every finite exponent set D j, `held_at` (Next/RANK/Possible.lean:57) turns `Paid.run` into `Allowed`, and `sold` (Soft/Supra.lean:127) gives width → ∞, so the claim misdescribes [L]. The status stays no-match because ϖ_{J_i} = o(s_i) has no counterpart: `Stage.power` is constrained only by `power_ge` and `deepPower` monotonicity (RG/History.lean:55,105).

[M] includes (14.marker-scales) in the lemma, and that equation prints ϖ_{J_i} = o(s_i) (E-section.tex:36-40), so it is a claim of the item. The only growth fact on `power` in [L] is monotonicity (`powers`, Price/Intent.lean:33, and the derived `deepPower`), with no little-o bound against the scale. The comparison windows of `Paid.run` are abstract, so no-match stands.
